comment: There is no MODE switch on the panel: EnverMini.cpp:564-572 puts the three modes on the menu, printed 'Envelope (off)', 'Function (red)' and 'Loop (yellow)' after the light colour that shows them. The four stage knobs have no CV jacks on this version. The census output order is Envelope first and Signal second, which is the reverse of their order down the panel.
